breaking_changes: Removed the ROCm backend for OpenMOSS on Linux; set backend to vulkan or cuda instead.
Removed the ROCm backend for sd-cpp on Windows; set backend to vulkan or auto instead.
The POST /v1/images/upscale endpoint now requires the 'upscaling' model label; models without it are rejected with a 400 error.

The /api/v1/system-info API now returns AMD GPU names in marketing form (e.g., 'AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (gfx1201)') instead of raw numeric codes; consumers that parse the name field for numeric versions need to adapt.
The release tagging tool no longer accepts --no-sign; omit the flag (now the default) or use --sign for signed tags.

checklist.author: @abn
checklist.text: On a Linux or macOS desktop without lemond running, launch lemonade-tray with --spawn-server and verify that lemond starts within 15 seconds, the tray menu populates, and quitting the tray causes lemond to terminate immediately without leaving an orphan process.

checklist.author: @RaulMermans
checklist.text: Run lemonade config set flm.flm_bin=builtin and confirm it returns an Unknown key error, then run lemonade config set flm.npu_bin=builtin and confirm it succeeds.

checklist.author: @Copilot
checklist.text: Run the release tagging tool in dry-run mode and confirm the output says 'would create and push annotated tag' rather than 'signed tag'.

checklist.author: @Copilot
checklist.text: Run the release tagging tool with the --sign flag in dry-run mode and confirm the output says 'would create and push signed tag'.

evidence.blockers: The lemonade-tray --spawn-server end-to-end lifecycle has not been exercised by a human on a real desktop. The release tagging tool's new unsigned-default path should be verified before the v2026.41 tag. Both are P1/P2 checks a tester can run before shipping.
evidence.breaking_changes: Five breaking changes ship in this release: ROCm backends removed for OpenMOSS (Linux) and sd-cpp (Windows) with vulkan/cuda/auto fallbacks; upscale endpoint now requires the 'upscaling' label; system-info AMD GPU names switched to marketing form; release tool replaced --no-sign with --sign (omit flag for default). All migrations are simple flag or config changes.
evidence.coverage: Range v2026.40.0..6f8e87b reviewed: 13 commits assessed with verdicts, evidence, and to-dos. All CI check evidence was recorded where applicable.
evidence.manual_testing: End-to-end tray spawn flow (lemond starts, tray connects, menu populates, tray quit kills lemond) on Linux and macOS. Release tool dry-run for both unsigned and signed paths. Config validation edge cases on /internal/config and /internal/set.
evidence.security: No security concerns observed across all 13 commits. The watchdog pipe uses FD_CLOEXEC and posix_spawn for safe subprocess lifecycle. Config validation tightening is a defensive improvement. No credential handling, supply-chain, or network call changes introduced.
